news.title: SpaceX confidentially files for IPO, setting stage for record offering
news.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX is reportedly targeting a valuation of around $1.75 trillion in its forthcoming IPO.

news.title: Iran threatens Nvidia, Apple and other tech giants with attacks
news.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard has warned a number of tech companies with Middle East operations that they'll be considered "legitimate targets."

news.title: Eli Lilly opposes push to pass Trump's drug pricing deals into law, CEO says
news.description: Eli Lilly opposes the White House's push to codify "most favored nation" drug pricing into law, CEO Dave Ricks said in an interview with CNBC.
